notes.title: Toilet Hero Version 0.0.6 Beta Update
notes.content: [p]Hi, heroes![/p][p]We’ve launched the version [b]0.0.6 beta[/b] update. This update fixes several important issues and optimizes the overall game experience.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680291/9fc09f1a82bbbee030ea41b5291c802be50debc0.png"][/img][/p][p]🔧 Optimizations and Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the issue with the character selection box in the Dispatch Bureau.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the description error for the Frost Sorceress formation buff.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the card name display error in the Goddess’s followers interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect attack target for the Frost Tornado.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the size display issue for certain dragon enemies in the Frosttongue Library.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized image loading to prevent a white flash screen during refresh.[/p][/*][*][p]Bolts and plungers no longer occupy inventory storage space.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all for your support and feedback! We will continue to optimize the game experience in future updates. Feel free to contact us through official channels if you encounter any problems. Happy gaming![/p][p]Toilet Hero Development Team[/p]

notes.title: Toilet Hero Version 0.0.5 Beta Update Log
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45680291/c1ae548874904448f396ec8fc5cee317c3d99ab0.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi, heroes![/p][p]We’ve released the 0.0.5 beta update, addressing several issues reported by players. Here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][p]🔧 [b]Optimizations and Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]The Library achievement feature has been temporarily disabled, pending future activation.[/p][/*][*][p]An independent close button has been added to the Help interface for easier navigation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where players were immediately teleported back after dungeon teleportation. You can now reach your target area normally.[/p][/*][*][p]The double-speed combat setting now remembers your preference and won't reset every time.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the character data of Goddess’s followers didn’t sync properly during the upgrades in camps.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing text in the descriptions of the Goddess’s followers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the target errors of certain card effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display issues with character deck information in dispatch teams.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all for your feedback and support! We’ll keep on hard-working to make the path of the plunger smoother![/p][p]Toilet Hero Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Version 0.0.4 Beta Update Log
notes.content:
[p]Hi, warriors![/p][p][/p][p]We've fixed some issues to make your plunge-tastic journey smoother! Version 0.0.4 Beta has been updated. Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][/p][p]🔧 [b]Optimizations & Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed Main Quest 5-5 Roadblock[/b]: No longer stuck in a literal logjam – flush your way to victory![/p][/*][*][p][b]Drained Gear Stats Glitch[/b]: Equipment stats from toilet pulls won’t go rogue anymore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Progress Bar Plunge Prevention[/b]: Main quest progress bars stay afloat when continuing your game. No more "down the drain" surprises![/p][/*][/list][p]Big thanks for your crap-tastic feedback! We’ll keep polishing this porcelain realm so you can plunge fearlessly.[/p][p]
Keep plunging forward! 💪🚽[/p][p]
The Toilet Hero Dev Team
[/p]

notes.title: Toilet Hero's First Platytest Is Now Live!
notes.content:
[p]Dear Heroes,
[/p][p]Yes, you read that right — this is no dream, no illusion — you are about to become a hero wielding a trusty plunger, rising from the toilet bowl!
[/p][p]The first playtest of Toilet Hero is officially OPEN! We welcome all warriors ready to save the toilet world in this utterly absurd fantasy RPG![/p][p][/p][h3] [b]In this world, you will:[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Start your "crappy" journey by plunging through toilets—proving even dirty deeds can make you stronger.[/p][/*][*][p]Meet eccentric goddesses to unlock exclusive skins and OP talents.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle the brain-bending Demon Lord who’s currently fuming over being marketed as a "pink twin-tailed loli".[/p][/*][*][p]Experience hybrid gameplay blending card strategy, dungeon crawling, and character progression![/p][/*][*][p]Unlock AFK glory with the Auto-Flush Mode—true idle freedom.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h3][b]We Need You![/b][/h3][p]This is a [u]closed playtest[/u]—your feedback is crucial to polish this "distinctly pungent" masterpiece![/p][p][/p][h3] [b]How to Join the Playtest?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Search “[b]Toilet Hero[/b]” on Steam[/p][/*][*][p]Click the “[b]Join the Playtest[/b]" button[/p][/*][*][p][b]WISHLIST US! [/b]💖[/p][/*][/list][p]
Ready to flush your way into the stinkiest adventure of your life? See you in-game!

Best Regards,[/p][p]The Toilet Hero Dev Team[/p]
